format:
  html:
    css:
      - styles-main.css
      - styles-auth.css
    toc: false

---

{{< include _navbar.html >}}

::: {.auth-page-bg}
::: {.auth-page-content}

<div class="auth-card">
  <img src="assets/logo.png" alt="AAIC Logo" class="auth-card-logo">
  <h2>Teacher Login</h2>
  <p class="auth-subtitle">Sign in to manage your classroom</p>

  <div class="auth-message" id="loginMessage"></div>

  <form onsubmit="handleTeacherLogin(event)">
    <div class="auth-field">
      <label for="loginEmail">Email</label>
      <input type="email" id="loginEmail" placeholder="Enter your email" required>
    </div>
    <div class="auth-field">
      <label for="loginPassword">Password</label>
      <input type="password" id="loginPassword" placeholder="Enter your password" required>
    </div>
    <div class="auth-forgot">
      <a href="reset-password.html">Forgot your password?</a>
    </div>
    <button type="submit" class="auth-btn">Log In</button>
  </form>

  <div class="auth-links">
    Don't have an account? <a href="signup.html">Sign Up</a>
  </div>
</div>

:::
:::

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<script src="js/supabase-config.js"></script>
<script src="js/auth.js"></script>
